```{r setup, include=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo       = FALSE,
  warning    = FALSE,
  message    = FALSE,
  error      = FALSE,
  fig.align  = "center",
  fig.width  = 10,
  fig.height = 6.5,
  out.width  = "75%",
  dpi        = 120
)

```

```{r libraries}
library(statwise)
statwise::clear_env()

```

```{r report-info}
# TODO: update report-info chunk
data_cut <- "08-24-2026"  # mm-dd-yyyy or mm_dd_yyyy
analysis_title <- "Analysis Title ABC"
```

<!-- This chunk applies styling to the report, including the top bar and section cards for headings at level 2 (e.g., ## Results). -->
```{r DO-NOT-MODIFY-THIS-CHUNK, echo=FALSE}
data_as_of <- if (exists("data_cut") && !is.na(data_cut)) {format(as.Date(gsub("_", "-", data_cut), format = "%m-%d-%Y"), "%B %d, %Y")} else {"N/A"}
statwise::report_topbar(title = analysis_title, data_as_of = data_as_of)
statwise::theme_selector()
statwise::section_cards()
```
